label: PIPELINE TEST (scripted model, not Gemma)
submission: V1.2 tree (experiment/v1.2, packaged with g4agent.packager --compile; sha256[:16]=023ff28002d06cd3)
harness: official swegemma 0.2.7 Evaluator, subprocess sandbox, macOS/py3.12
scenario: The scripted model sends old_string/new_string with quotes escaped once (the copy error reported in discussion 744272), first to edit_file, then unchanged to code-edit/edit.py.
result: edit_file -> FileEditError 'old_string not found'; edit.py -> EDITED (unescaped x1 match) with real quotes in the file; tests pass; graded resolved.
also_shows: nav.py read output reaches the model escaped once (\") while edit_file/submit_patch results are escaped twice ({"result": "{\"status\"..."}).
notes: Proves the mechanism and the fix path inside the official harness. Says nothing about how often real Gemma makes this error or uses the fallback.
